description.value: Accent Inns Burnaby is a BC family-owned hotel close to the Gilmore SkyTrain station, positioning itself as one of the most bike-friendly lodging options in Canada with complimentary bike rentals available to guests. The property is Rainbow Registered, holds BC Hotel Association housekeeping awards, and hosts the locally operated Bin 4 Burger Lounge on site. Its accessible location off Highway 1 and proximity to transit makes it a practical base for cyclists exploring the Greater Vancouver area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, operating hotel at 3777 Henning Dr, Burnaby with phone and address matching OSM. The amenities list explicitly includes 'Bike friendly with free bike rentals' and the about-us page describes Accent Inns as 'the most bike-friendly and pet-friendly hotel chain in Canada,' but neither the main page nor the fetched subpages describe a specific secure overnight storage arrangement (locked room, garage, etc.). Free in-room WiFi is confirmed both by the website amenity list and OSM tags; an on-site restaurant (Bin 4 Burger Lounge) confirms nearby evening food.
concerns: The /about-us/bike-friendly/ subpage was not fetched; it may contain specific details about secure bike storage arrangements that could satisfy the required criteria. A follow-up fetch of that page is recommended.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible hotel with confirmed bike-friendly branding, free bike rentals, and on-site food — a clear inclusion for touring cyclists.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Bikes explicitly allowed in guest rooms: 'Love your bike? Bring it to your room. No need to leave it in storage where you can't see it.' Bike-friendly rooms available on request

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Bin 4 Burger Lounge serving burgers, craft beers, cocktails, and gluten-free/vegetarian options

Laundry.detail: 'A laundry room in case it's not just your bike that needs washing.'
